description: Set a paragraph style's nested styles (a character style up to a delimiter), nested line styles (a character style for N lines) or GREP styles (a character style wherever a GREP pattern matches): replace, add, remove one or clear them; or insert an End Nested Style Here character into text (Drop Caps and Nested Styles, GREP Style)

action.description: replace all entries, add entries, remove the entry at removeIndex, clear all, or insert End Nested Style Here at the end of text

entries.description: Entries in order. Nested: characterStyle, delimiter (a NestedStyleDelimiters name such as ANY_WORD, SENTENCE, TABS, REPEAT, END_NESTED_STYLE, or literal characters), repetition, inclusive. Line: characterStyle, lineCount, repeatLast. GREP: characterStyle, grepExpression

delimiter.description: Nested: what the style runs up to

inclusive.description: Nested: include the delimiter (Through) rather than stop before it (Up to)

repeatLast.description: Line: repeat the last N entries

repetition.description: Nested: how many delimiters (or, with REPEAT, how many previous entries to loop)

style.description: The paragraph style: a style name, or "Group/Style" for a style inside a style group

text.description: Which text: a text frame by id (the text in the frame, or its whole story), optionally narrowed to a paragraph or character range; or selection: true for the selected text

characters.description: First and last character index within the frame or story (0-based, inclusive)

paragraphs.description: First and last paragraph index within the frame or story (0-based, inclusive)

selection.description: Use the selected text, or the text of the selected text frame

story.description: Use the whole story the frame belongs to, not only the text in the frame

name: set_nested_styles
title: Set Nested Styles
